import { toServer, toClient, askServer, receive, receiveV1, ClientReady, ServerNetwork, ClientNetwork, ToServer } from "./net";
declare const player: Player;
declare const door: Model;
const Analytics = toServer<"Upgrades" | "SkinShop">("Analytics.ScreenOpened");
const Codes = toClient<"Ok" | "Invalid" | "Expired">("Codes.Result");
const Num = toClient<1 | 2 | 3>("X.Num");
const Pick = askServer<"a" | "b", number>("X.Pick");
const DoorToggle = toServer<{ readonly door: Model; readonly open: boolean }>("Doors.Toggle");
const StandUp = toServer<undefined>("Seating.Stand");
const Prof = askServer<{ readonly userId: number }, { name: string } | undefined>("PlayerCard.Profile");
// --- K1 negatives (line 12 on)
ClientNetwork.send(Analytics, "Nope");                                   // N1  L12
ServerNetwork.send(player, Num, 4);                                      // N2  L13
ClientNetwork.ask(Pick, "c");                                            // N3  L14
ClientNetwork.send(Codes, "Ok");                                         // N4  L15 wrong direction
ServerNetwork.send(player, DoorToggle as never as typeof Analytics, "Upgrades"); // N4b L16 wrong direction: the cast still yields a ToServer token
ClientNetwork.send(DoorToggle, { door, open: 1 });                       // N5  L17
ClientNetwork.send(StandUp, undefined);                                  // N6  L18 no-payload message takes no argument
declare const wide: ToServer<{ x: number | string }>;
const narrow: ToServer<{ x: number }> = wide;                            // N7  L20 invariance
// --- K16: same wrong callbacks under v2 (single signature) and v1 (overloads)
export class V2 {
	readonly a = receive(Prof, (p, { userId }) => { print(userId); });   // N8  L23 request callback with no return
	readonly b = receive(ClientReady, (p) => 5);                         // N9  L24 ClientReady non-function return
	readonly c = receive(DoorToggle, (p, payload: string) => {});         // N10 L25 wrong payload annotation
	readonly d = receive(Codes, (p: Player, r) => {});                    // N11 L26 client callback given a player
	readonly e = receive(Pick, (p, which) => "one");                     // N12 L27 wrong response type
	readonly f = receive(5 as unknown as number, () => {});               // N13 L28 not a target
}
export class V1 {
	readonly a = receiveV1(Prof, (p, { userId }) => { print(userId); }); // L31
	readonly b = receiveV1(ClientReady, (p) => 5);                       // L32
	readonly c = receiveV1(DoorToggle, (p, payload: string) => {});       // L33
	readonly d = receiveV1(Codes, (p: Player, r) => {});                  // L34
	readonly e = receiveV1(Pick, (p, which) => "one");                   // L35
}
